verdict.rationale: moq-relay is documented as a server that connects publishers to subscribers. Docs say content is sent only when someone is watching, and a production report describes one relay fanning out to independent subscribers. The evidence does not explicitly document per-participant, per-track selective forwarding, where each subscriber receives only the tracks it subscribed to; that behavior is implied by the subscribe model rather than stated. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-track subscription filtering at the relay, hands-on corroboration that unsubscribed tracks are not forwarded to a participant.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, media routes through a selective forwarding unit or relay that delivers only the tracks each participant subscribes to
